visual_tone: warm, grounded, real-life interiors with subtle mystical details (charts, sky motifs)
camera_style: stable for A-roll; for B-roll use quick push-ins, handheld tracking, and over-shoulder shots inside real homes
mood: intimate, hopeful, gently confronting unhealed patterns without being harsh
color_palette: warm tones, soft highlights, muted shadows, natural indoor lighting with occasional deep blues for astro moments
avoid: no harsh lighting, no text overlays, no logos, no stock-photo feel, avoid generic forests/rivers/abstract glowing walls unless the script line explicitly calls for nature or that symbol
format: vertical 9:16, must look like real video not a photograph, continuous but not floaty motion throughout
filler_clip: Soft morning light over an open astrology chart and a mug on a kitchen table. Camera: gentle overhead push-in. Paper texture, a pen nearby, no people, no text.
